scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @reservation-system/api" "npm run dev -w @reservation-system/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @reservation-system/api && npm run build -w @reservation-system/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @reservation-system/api && npm run typecheck -w @reservation-system/web
scripts.audit:security: npm audit --audit-level=low && npm audit --workspaces=false --prefix apps/api --audit-level=low && npm audit --workspaces=false --prefix apps/web --audit-level=low
scripts.test:operations: npm run test:operations -w @reservation-system/api && npm run test:operations -w @reservation-system/web
